cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
for f in ['word/document.xml','word/header1.xml','word/footer1.xml']:
    d=z.read(f).decode('utf-8')
    # find uppercase tokens
    toks=set(re.findall(r'[A-Z][A-Z_]{2,}',re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',d)))
    print('===',f,'=== tokens:',sorted(toks))
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
d=z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
import re
# Pretty-ish: split paragraphs
for i,m in enumerate(re.finditer(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>',d,re.S)):
    seg=m.group(0)
    txt=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',seg,re.S))
    if txt.strip():
        print(i,repr(txt))
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
d=z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
print('tbl count',d.count('<w:tbl>'),'nested? ')
# check header/footer run splitting
for f in ['word/header1.xml','word/footer1.xml']:
    x=z.read(f).decode('utf-8')
    for p in re.findall(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>',x,re.S):
        t=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',p,re.S))
        if t.strip(): print(f,repr(t))
"

import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
for f in ['word/document.xml','word/header1.xml','word/footer1.xml']:
    d=z.read(f).decode('utf-8')
